purpose: Brand fidelity is decided from the encoded bytes, never read back through Blender's colour management. A flat emission patch of the brand blue is rendered under each transform and decoded with PIL.

AgX.role: negative control — must NOT be exact; the plan measured #467ECF

rule: Every object in this directory was rendered with view_transform Standard (see each .render.json). Nothing ships when the Standard patch is not exact or the AgX patch is.
